segments: Every night at two a.m., her brain screens the classics.
The wave that wasn't for her.
Then the one that isn't funny.
The last thing she said to her sister.
So she opened Heartly and wrote that one out.
This one keeps replaying, it said, because part of you still wants to fix it.
Next morning, she texted her sister.
Some reruns are just cringe. Some are unfinished.
